description: News photograph of Speaker of the House Nancy Pelosi in a cream-colored suit, standing before multiple U.S. flags in an ornate Capitol setting, holding an open Bible while speaking. A patterned cloth face mask is pulled down around her neck. Consistent with her June 2020 remarks invoking scripture amid the George Floyd protests.

description: Annotated screenshot of a Google Trends 'Interest over time' chart for the search term 'black lives matter' in the United States over the past five years (mid-2015 to mid-2020). Added red/blue labels with arrows mark a spike in Summer 2016 before the 2016 Election, and a much larger spike in Summer 2020 with an arrow pointing past the chart edge labeled 2020 Election. The annotations imply BLM search interest surges ahead of presidential elections.
